family.description: Circadian-associated transcriptional repressor (Ciart or Chrono) is a negative regulatory component of the circadian clock. It functions as a transcriptional repressor, modulating BMAL1-CLOCK activity. It also regulates metabolic pathways such as the glucocorticoid response triggered by behavioral stress [[cite:PUB00075744],[cite:PUB00075743],[cite:PUB00075745]].
family.name: Circadian-associated transcriptional repressor
